config.entry_order: ascending original prefix position (old suffix lengths 6 down to 2)
config.entry_budget: floor(remaining case apply / remaining eligible entries), no carry backwards
config.move_order: destabilize IDs ascending, then applicable-rank inversion/multiplication/conjugation IDs ascending
config.rank_policy: no stabilization; rank never increases; rank<=2 throughout search
config.depth_policy: replacement strictly shorter than old tail; at most 5; rank lower bound prunes
config.state_policy: exact freely reduced ordered tuple including rank; no quotient or rename
config.dominance: same state: keep Pareto labels (depth, added-work, local-peak); first path retained on equal labels
config.local_length_policy: official max_total_relator_length only; local length increases permitted
config.candidate_choice: full length, full work, full peak, prefix position, replacement move tuple
config.claim_scope: bounded certificate postprocessing; not a from-scratch solver, global optimality, or literature novelty claim
